lines.text: We can offer your team forty seats on the annual plan.
lines.name: Omar

lines.text: The list price is 18 dollars per seat per month.
lines.name: Omar

lines.text: We were hoping for something lower since we are a long term customer.
For a two year commitment I can give you a discount of 10 percent.
lines.name: Omar

lines.text: What happens to the price if we need more seats in the second year?
I would have to ask my manager about that.
lines.name: Omar

lines.text: I will send you the draft contract on Monday with both options.
lines.name: Omar

lines.text: Good. We need to count the people who really need access first.
I will confirm our final headcount to you by the end of this week.
Right now my best guess is 40 seats, maybe a few more.
We will go with the two year term if the draft shows the discount in writing.
It will. I will make sure of that.
lines.name: Omar
